## Content

DaggerML records research computations as durable, inspectable, cacheable DAGs.
Pick the path that matches what you are trying to accomplish.

### Start using DaggerML

New to DaggerML? Read [Why DaggerML?](why-daggerml.qmd), then follow
[Get started](getting-started.qmd) to install the package, initialize a project,
and record your first DAG. Continue through [Use DaggerML](use/README.qmd) for
concepts, task-focused guides, and exact API reference.

### Learn from working code

[Examples](examples/index.qmd) contains executable lessons with matching
downloads. Start with the script executor, a class-based computation, or the
multi-file analysis report.

### Build integrations

[Extend DaggerML](extend/index.qmd) covers adapters, executors, codecs, plugin
registration, and the contracts that connect them to the runtime.

### Contribute to DaggerML

[Develop DaggerML](develop/README.qmd) explains local setup, testing, the
codebase map, and the architecture behind the public Python and command-line
surfaces.

### Keep close at hand

- [Sharp bits and security](sharp-bits-and-security.qmd): operational caveats and known security limitations.
- [Glossary](glossary.qmd): shared terms.
